caption: The drawing features an embroidered design of a floral arrangement set within a square green border, with the main design area on a beige or off-white fabric background. The composition consists of multiple flowers and leaves, each rendered in different colors: the flowers include shades of yellow, blue, white, and brown, while the leaves are various shades of green. There are also small red flower clusters at the top of the design. The embroidery is dense, with several flowers overlapping and intermingled stems and leaves, creating a compact central bouquet within the bordered area. Outside the green border, the background is plain and light-colored with fine pencil lines indicating the outline of the square and the border. There are no additional objects present in the drawing.
title: Embroidery Piece
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
